projects.title: Hadithi
projects.summary: An immersive, multilingual LLM application for source-grounded conversations with cultural legends, spanning interactive environments, speech transcription and validated citations.
projects.shows: LLM application design, cultural safeguards, structured output validation, multilingual UX and production deployment.

projects.title: Hybrid Search & Retrieval Evaluation
projects.summary: Hybrid BM25 + ANN + transformer reranking over 8,807 Netflix records behind a cached FastAPI service, with latency benchmarks and a tool-calling agent with grounding checks.
projects.shows: retrieval, serving, evaluation, tests, CI and Docker.

projects.title: Sloth Archivist
projects.summary: An offline CLI that triages photo folders with rules first, a local vision model second, and logs every decision. Nothing is deleted.
projects.shows: pipeline design, safe automation, schema-validated model output.
